# stackit_identity_user (Data Source)

Gets details about a STACKIT Identity user in an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stackit_identity_user" "user" {
  organization_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  user_id         = "zzzzzzzz-zzzz-zzzz-zzzz-zzzzzzzzzzzz"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) STACKIT Organization ID to which the user belongs.
- `user_id` (String) The internal UUID of the user to look up.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the user.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource ID, structured as "`organization_id`,`user_id`".
